nodes.name: KYC case identity
nodes.summary: Accept only tenant and case identity; the subject, records and policy authority come from the canonical case store.

payload.reason: Authoritative policy context and intake prerequisites are being validated.

nodes.name: Pin policy authority evidence
nodes.summary: Materialize the case's immutable policy binding as authoritative canonical evidence and a policy claim; the screening-ready gate checks both.

nodes.name: decision.policy.resolve
nodes.summary: Resolve the admitted effective tenant policy snapshot.

payload.reason: The identity connector did not positively verify the document (outcome {{ output.outcome }}).

nodes.name: Identity document verification
nodes.summary: Acquire through wiring:persona:identity.document.verify; write the normalized VerificationRecord records, or an incomplete-check finding when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Document evidence package
nodes.summary: Acquire through evidence:package; write the normalized DocumentVersion, DocumentPage, Evidence records, or an incomplete-check finding when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Identity acquisition barrier
nodes.summary: Wait for every acquisition; a failed provider stays visible as a rejected settlement and its records are simply absent (the skill then reports CONTEXT_MISSING).

nodes.name: entity.identity.verify
nodes.summary: Evaluate captured verification records against allowed methods and evidence.

nodes.name: document.classify
nodes.summary: Classify supported text documents using pinned keyword rules, retaining unknowns.

nodes.name: document.fields.extract
nodes.summary: Extract explicit label:value text fields with exact source character spans.

nodes.name: document.evidence.link
nodes.summary: Verify assertion values against exact document-version character spans.

nodes.name: document.classify.catalog
nodes.summary: Classify each document version into the document field catalog by exact title, name and alias matches with spans; ambiguity stays UNKNOWN.

nodes.name: document.fields.contract_extract
nodes.summary: Extract every field of each classified document's catalog contract through an admitted provider, then validate schema, spans and source binding deterministically.

nodes.name: document.validity.assess
nodes.summary: Assess issue and expiry dates at the invocation's as-of time with their stated precision; an absent or partial date stays undetermined, never invented.

nodes.name: document.consistency.assess
nodes.summary: Detect a subject's field stated with different values, across document versions or within one, with every conflicting assertion and its source reference.

document_requirements.description: Government identity document evidencing legal name and date of birth
Evidence of the residential or principal business street address
Evidence of the taxpayer identification number asserted at intake

nodes.name: document.requirements.resolve
nodes.summary: Resolve the policy's document requirements (each satisfied by any one of its catalog types) against the classified documents present, and list candidate evidence options for the entity package or review event.

nodes.name: document.request.compose
nodes.summary: Write a missing-document request from the catalog's display name and key fields; nothing is sent.

nodes.name: party.profile.build
nodes.summary: Assemble sourced party profiles while retaining distinct relationship roles.

nodes.name: party.type.classify
nodes.summary: Classify relationship customer types from configured mappings.

payload.reason: Screening readiness policy gate allowed the case to proceed.

nodes.name: Screening readiness gate (OPA)
nodes.summary: Before screening: pinned policy authority, claim digest and CIP attributes on the canonical case. Anything but ALLOW ends the run.

payload.reason: OpenSanctions returned at least one sanctions or linked-entity candidate.

nodes.name: OpenSanctions sanctions screen
nodes.summary: Acquire through opensanctions:sanctions; write the normalized WatchlistEntry, ScreeningHit or NegativeSearchEvidence records, or an incomplete-check finding when the check established nothing.

payload.reason: OpenSanctions returned at least one politically exposed person candidate.

nodes.name: OpenSanctions PEP screen
nodes.summary: Acquire through opensanctions:pep; write the normalized WatchlistEntry, ScreeningHit or NegativeSearchEvidence records, or an incomplete-check finding when the check established nothing.

payload.reason: The adverse-media connector returned material adverse media for review.
The adverse-media connector reported a failed screen; the subject needs review.

nodes.name: Adverse-media screen
nodes.summary: Acquire through wiring:complyadvantage:screening.adverse_media; write the normalized AdverseMediaEvent or NegativeSearchEvidence records, or an incomplete-check finding when the check established nothing.

nodes.name: Screening acquisition barrier
nodes.summary: Wait for every acquisition; a failed provider stays visible as a rejected settlement and its records are simply absent (the skill then reports CONTEXT_MISSING).

nodes.name: entity.resolve
nodes.summary: Resolve by corroborated identifiers; name similarity alone leaves candidates unresolved.

nodes.name: screening.name.normalize
nodes.summary: Apply deterministic Unicode normalization while retaining the original script.

nodes.name: screening.sanctions.execute
nodes.summary: Evaluate admitted sanctions search records, retain candidates and identify incomplete subject coverage.

nodes.name: screening.pep.execute
nodes.summary: Evaluate admitted pep search records, retain candidates and identify incomplete subject coverage.

nodes.name: screening.adverse_media.execute
nodes.summary: Search captured media subjects while retaining allegations and negative scope.

nodes.name: screening.match.disambiguate
nodes.summary: Recommend review/false-match based on explicit contradictory identifiers.

nodes.name: risk.factor.evaluate
nodes.summary: Map a factor value through an explicitly configured score table.

nodes.name: risk.customer.assess
nodes.summary: Calculate a pinned weighted score with unknown factors retained and no acceptance decision.

nodes.name: risk.tier.assign
nodes.summary: Map a numeric score to a configured recommended tier.

payload.description: Scope EDD under the pinned policy, collect and review supporting evidence, obtain the required acceptance approval and record current control assessments before resuming.

nodes.name: edd.trigger.evaluate
nodes.summary: Evaluate explicit EDD trigger predicates and preserve unknown inputs.

nodes.name: evidence.sufficiency.assess
nodes.summary: Assess evidence coverage against explicit pinned requirement IDs.

payload.reason: Decision readiness policy gate confirmed a complete KYC packet.

nodes.name: Decision readiness gate (OPA)
nodes.summary: Before the library decision skills: policy context, screening coverage and freshness, investigation, evidence obligations and contradictions. Anything but ALLOW ends the run.

nodes.name: decision.requirements.compile
nodes.summary: Compile requirement applicability with explicit unknown conditions.

payload.rationale: Library decision.recommendation.generate returned {{ output.computation.payload.recommendation }}; a library recommendation is never an automatic approval.

nodes.name: decision.recommendation.generate
nodes.summary: Map control outcomes to a policy-defined review recommendation.

payload.reason: Disposition gate requires independent human review: {{ output.reasonCode }}

nodes.name: Policy disposition gate (OPA)
nodes.summary: Before recording a disposition: what, if anything, the platform may reach without a human. No automatic decline; ALLOW, REVIEW and ERROR all go to dual-control human approval.

nodes.name: decision.disposition.record
nodes.summary: Record a human-approved disposition only with satisfied acceptance controls.

nodes.name: Independent approval: decision.disposition.record
nodes.summary: The disposition skill's payload is a proposal until two distinct authorized reviewers record the same decision (durable dual control).

nodes.name: Release approved effects: decision.disposition.record
nodes.summary: Commit the skill's held effects after an approval (re-validating case sequence and expiry), or discard them after a rejection; an external action without an outbound route stays a pending intent.

payload.description: Perform the policy-scoped periodic CDD review; reassess material changes and retain the evidence and authorized outcome.

sources.review_interval_seconds: owner_inputs.D09 by the cohort's riskTier (30-day months, to seconds)

nodes.name: monitor.customer.schedule
nodes.summary: Persist an idempotent next-review schedule using the configured interval.

nodes.name: KYC stopped for handoff
nodes.summary: An OPA gate did not continue, a library success condition did not hold, or a reviewer rejected the disposition; the case stays open for workflow handoff.

nodes.name: KYC result
nodes.summary: Reached only after dual-control approval of the disposition and the monitoring schedule; links the run to the case. Final disposition remains a separately authorized case command.

metadata.name: KYC v2
metadata.objective: Individual KYC (CDD onboarding) on the financial-crime skill library: connectors acquire data into canonical records, library skills reason over them with the pinned US KYC policy as their policy context, OPA decision-table gates guard each stage, and two independent humans approve the disposition. Synthetic library skills; not production-qualified.
